## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her decorated hat before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) become instant friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home happily, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a treat of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to herself that she is becoming fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>

> During class at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.
>

A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Unhappy with the separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her warmly and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sends her a secret note. Over the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) focuses fiercely on her studies and engages in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in seeking help for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.
>

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.
>

> Noticing how plain Anne's clothes are compared to other girls', [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) shop, but gets so intimidated by the clerk that he ends up buying rakes, seed, and sugar instead. He enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to buy and sew the fashionable brown dress, which he presents to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a snowy Christmas morning alongside a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed by the gifts and goes on to star in the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Christmas concert.
>

> On Christmas morning, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a pair of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the concert. The evening concert is a huge success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performing wonderfully in her new dress. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss how proud they are of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and consider her future education.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comes home to find tea not prepared and learns that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green using dye bought from a peddler. When washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has to cut Anne's hair off short. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school with her hair shingled, bearing the humiliation as penance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful summer outdoors before returning to her studies, discussing her growing maturity and moral thoughts with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). As the Queen's class prepares for the fateful [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid physical growth and quiet demeanor, sharing her fears of losing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to anxiously await the results. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings news that the pass list is out and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has tied for first place on the Island with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her joyful success with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), concluding the evening with a peaceful visit to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>

> After a successful encore and compliment-filled supper, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) head home with [Billy](../character/billy.md). During the ride, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share compliments and express envy of the wealthy hotel guests, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asserts her contentment with who she is and the love she has back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>

> On their way back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discover a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impetuously sells the animal on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home, she discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes in horror that she has mistakenly sold Mr. Harrison's cow.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive around canvassing their assigned road to raise money for painting the hall on behalf of the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They encounter various eccentric neighbors, including grim Miss Eliza, her optimistic sister Catherine, a stressed husband in an apron, and an overly neat Mrs. White.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their canvassing efforts, encountering a variety of colorful neighbors across [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon hearing that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a newborn son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) seizes the opportunity to secure a large five-dollar donation from the proud father. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute to the cause.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hurriedly removes the toad using a fire shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can discover it, then notices [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signaling from her window.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's forgotten overgrown garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) tells Hester's tragic and romantic story.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss the life and memory of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) while lingering in her garden. Afterwards, they explore the nearby woods and fields, enjoying a lunch by a brook where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) share poetic thoughts on nature and souls before returning home at sunset.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about Marilla's improving eyesight and the upcoming [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar, then returns home to learn that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) will remain with them through the fall. She recalls disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for eating forbidden jam, after which she attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) alerts everyone to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) attempt to talk Judson out of it, but he refuses to change his mind.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) attempt to convince [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to paint advertisements on his fences, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose him, Judson agrees to drop the advertisement plan to secure her silence.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

> After a conversation with [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets off with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to search for a replacement willow-ware platter. Their search leads them to the Copp house on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets stuck after crashing through the roof of a duckhouse while peering through the pantry window. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stays with her through a rainstorm until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns home, frees [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with an axe, and agrees to host tea and discuss selling her platter.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P60](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) for looking in her window, and [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea. [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) agrees to sell her willow-ware platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars, revealing she is saving money for her upcoming marriage. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) with the platter, laughing over their adventure.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P59](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0059), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

> Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> School resumes, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Dora's first days and Mirabel Cotton's ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost on their way to a tea party and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they are invited to stay for tea by the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a charming tea party with Miss Lavendar and her young assistant, Charlotta the Fourth. After showing off her echoes in the garden and explaining Charlotta's name, Miss Lavendar becomes suddenly quiet and worn when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). The girls take their leave, promising to visit again soon.
>

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>

The two friends reaffirm their deep and lasting friendship as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to head to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>

> As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
